method.reason: Choose B3LYP, a widely used hybrid GGA functional, for geometry optimization and vibrational-frequency analysis of neutral singlet ethanol. This choice is based on official ORCA documentation for the functional; it does not by itself establish scientific validation.

sources.quote: B3LYP [230] B3LYP 20 The popular B3LYP functional (20% HF exchange) as defined in the TurboMole program system (LDAOPT C_VWN5)

basis.reason: Choose def2-TZVP, a polarized valence triple-zeta orbital basis set suitable for C/H/O-containing organic molecules, for the requested optimization and frequency calculation. This is a documentation-supported basis selection, not a claim of scientific validation.

sources.quote: The easiest way to use orbital and auxiliary basis sets in ORCA is via the simple input keywords. All available orbital basis set keywords can be found in Section 2.7.2 and all auxiliary basis set options in Section 2.7.4. For example, the Karlsruhe def2-TZVP basis set can be invoked via the def2-TZVP keyword.
